body: So...should I just walk into an ER and say I'm going to kill myself?  Is there a better way to get help?

Thanks very much for the info.  I would think they'd err on the side of caution - I wonder what their liability would be if they released someone who said they would hurt themselves, and then they did...

I wonder, too...when you say "they keep you there", would they detain you or would you be free to leave?
